articles.author: Elon Musk
articles.description:
How many real people are still on the Internet?

Mario Nawfal: AI BOTS RUN THE INTERNET NOW
Congrats, humans: you officially lost the internet to AI-powered bots in 2024.
Over half of all web traffic is now bots, and many of them up to no good.
They are stealing passwords, crashing sites, faking clicks, and even pretending to be you.

articles.author: Elon Musk
articles.description:
RT John Kraus
This Super Heavy booster flies again tomorrow. It is the first booster reuse of the Starship program, and comes after just eight prior flights.
Falcon 9 took until flight 32 to see a booster reuse. That turnaround was almost a year — this turnaround is ~4 months.
Significant.
